data.action: 点心店门口检查怀旧糖果后递给镜头，外套和侧马尾迎风轻动
data.description: 【小镇粗点心店·午后】栞那穿着外出便装站在点心店门口，双手抱着刚买的纸袋，先挑出一颗糖确认包装，再把最怀旧的那颗递给镜头。
data.lighting: late afternoon street light and warm shop glow
data.mood: 把童年味道带进今天的外出
data.promptProse: Outside the town sweet shop, Kanna holds her new paper bag against her cream blouse and dark-red midi skirt, checking one candy's wrapper before offering the most nostalgic piece toward the camera. Her light jacket remains clear in horizontal medium view. The shop doorway and shelves extend behind her. Late-afternoon street light catches the wrapper and bag fold, while warm indoor glow fills the shade around her hand.
data.title: 明月栞那 · 粗点心店的纸袋
